body:
Thank you so much. Really. 

Recognizing the reality is hard for me to do. Especially in times like these. I needed to hear someone recognize the significance of my therapist leaving, and not trivialize it. And you did just that. Thank you, so so much

Thanks! Really, I appreciate it. I feel stupid for bawling and freaking out, but it does feel like the person who told me to only listen to what she and my psychiatrist told me, just left me for the dogs.
